actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: 4/7/2025 CR H1431)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote.
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H1553)

At the conclusion of debate, the chair put the question on the motion to suspend the rules. Mr. Bost objected to the vote on the grounds that a quorum was not present. Further proceedings on the motion were postponed. The point of no quorum was considered as withdrawn.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 981.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H1430-4132)
Mr. Bost moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the Subcommittee on Economic Opportunity.
Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans applying for VA educational assistance, educational institutions participating in VA programs, and school certifying officials.
dimensions.evidence: educational institutions must provide to an individual a form under paragraph (1)

dimensions.assessment: Provides an administrative adjustment allowing estimated information on disclosure forms when exact data is unavailable.
dimensions.evidence: include, in place of the information that may be inaccurate or incomplete, the best estimate available

dimensions.assessment: Does not outline significant federal spending changes or appropriations, focusing primarily on administrative compliance.
Amends existing statutory provisions concerning educational program approvals and VA training publication mandates.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3679(f)(5) of title 38, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory changes to program approval exemptions and creates an ongoing requirement to update a website.
dimensions.evidence: shall establish a website to serve as a central location... and shall update such information on a regular basis

missing_information: Cost to establish and maintain the Department of Veterans Affairs website.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill makes narrow adjustments to educational institution disclosure requirements and requires the VA to maintain an online training resource for school certifying officials.
